rationale: The agent did not follow policy. It appears to have canceled the entire order outright and provided refund details without first authenticating the user or confirming the cancellation. The user initially asked about splitting payment and, failing that, about canceling the most expensive item or switching items to cheaper options before fully canceling; none of these were addressed. There is no evidence of authentication or of a confirmation step before an order-changing write, and the detailed refund/payment info is unsupported by visible tool use. Therefore, the outcome fails the required standards.
